texts: The Sunken Cove holds a single lantern.
The iron bands reinforce the Stilllight Lantern.

fields.sentence: The Sunken Cove holds a single lantern.

q1_issues.issue: "a single lantern" states an exact count / exclusivity ("only one"), but the parse slots `single` as a descriptive property of the lantern, asserting the lantern is single rather than that the cove holds exactly one.

q2_gaps: quantity-emphasis "a single N" on a SINGULAR indefinite: `Cardinality` / `CardinalityAtLeast` are defined only over a plural group witness, and the closest analogue the instruction set names ("only one N") is itself a registered gap under Focus particles, so nothing licenses an exact-count-one carrier here
review.notes: Everything else is squarely licensed: "Sunken Cove" is a capitalized run exceeding the bare class word, so name + kind-word type atom is the Names-and-casing pattern, and `Agent` on stative-transitive "hold" matches the instruction set's own "the tank holds forty litres" example.

issues.reason: "single" quantifies the NP (exactly one lantern) rather than describing the lantern, and the instruction set routes count words to Cardinality or to strength and never to a property atom ("vague counts ... go under Cardinality ..., not a lone witness"; "do not use a witness for proportion words"), so (Member sk_lantern_1 single) predicates of the lantern a property the text never attributes to it.

gaps_confirmed: exact count-emphasis on a SINGULAR indefinite ("a single N"): Cardinality/CardinalityAtLeast are defined over a group witness, and the nearest directive - the Focus-particles bullet's "only one N" -> "emit the exact Cardinality and leave the particle out" - never says how that count attaches when no plural group is present
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form carries the count as an exact Cardinality on a counted lantern group filling Theme - (GroupOf sk_group_1 lantern) (Cardinality sk_group_1 1) - per the Focus-particles directive to emit the exact Cardinality; if a singleton group is refused for a singular indefinite, the licensed fallback is to drop the count word and record the gap ("leave the unrepresentable out rather than mis-slot it"), and a (Member sk_lantern_1 single) property atom is licensed under neither route.
adjudication.notes: The rest is squarely licensed: the capitalized run "Sunken Cove" exceeds the bare class word so Name + kind type atom is the Names-and-casing pattern, and Agent/Theme on stative-transitive "hold" follows the prompt's own "the tank holds forty litres" ruling.

fields.sentence: The iron bands reinforce the Stilllight Lantern.

review.notes: Definite plural takes a group witness with the fusing classifier in the kind slot, iron is a noun modifier so no modifier genus is exposed, and the multi-word name gets one opaque symbol plus its Name and kind atoms. The per-member distribution rule is licensed (reinforce is not a reciprocal/aggregate predicate), though a joint/cumulative reading of the bands is also available.
